reviews.summary: The live site has the alternate links on the home, about and day pages. The day page also links its index.json, and build.json reports a clean alternate_check. The other endpoints return 200 and an unknown path returns 404.

The live home page and the 2026-11-13 day page each carry exactly one try-next paragraph in the right place, linking to /try/ and /go/github/. build.json shows try_check with missing [] and every other check list empty. The required URLs return 200 and the unknown page returns 404.

Live day pages carry the lead in title and description, are unique per day, and are within limits. build.json has a clean snippet_check, the other checks are empty, and the endpoints and the 404 behave as required.

Day, home and product titles now name an event with the short suffix ' · AI diary', and snippet_check covers 30 pages with all lists empty. All other checks stay clean and the neighbour URLs return 200, with the 404 page returning 404.

Every acceptance criterion is met on the live site. The four titles end on whole words and build.json shows the new dangling_titles and grammar_check fields empty. I did not open the individual lists inside each seo_check/other check beyond what build.json shows.

The live titles on the day page, the home page and the Luz Amanhã page all carry at least 25 characters of event text. build.json shows short_titles empty and both self-tests 'ok', and every other check list is empty. The other endpoints return 200 and the bogus URL returns 404.

Both icon files return 200 with image types and are under 20 KB. The three sampled pages each have one icon link to /favicon.ico and one apple-touch-icon link. build.json shows icon_check for 31 pages with empty lists, the other checks are empty, and the neighbour endpoints and the 404 behave as before.
